name: 행사 참석 확인 폼 메이커
tagline: Builds an event RSVP form, deploys it, and hands you the door QR code
description: Made for meetup hosts. Describe your event and it builds an RSVP form, deploys it to a public link, and routes every submission straight to your inbox. It also produces a door code for attendees to scan on arrival, so the same form covers both sign-up and check-in.
author: brandonchung75
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
